10147: RV resort in Kanab with full-hookup back-in and pull-through sites (30- and 50-amp) on large gravel pads, plus tent sites, yurts, Conestoga glamping wagons and apartments.  Pool, bathhouse, laundry, general store, dog park and a dump station.  Stays by the day, week, month or year, booked online through ResNexus. --Claude
10507: City of Newport RV park next to the rodeo grounds and city park, less than an hour from North Spokane: 20 pull-through sites (20 by 70 ft) with water, 50-amp power, sewer and Wi-Fi, and an on-site camp host.  No tents and no long-term rentals; 10 nights at most.  Trailers up to 35 ft; call ahead about a larger motorhome.  Open April 15 to October 15, weather permitting. --Claude
10515: PacifiCorp park on Lake Merwin, part of the Lewis River hydro project: 56 campsites without hookups, a 15-site group camp, water, restrooms, showers and a dump station, though RV tanks can't be filled here.  Swimming beach, two-lane boat ramp and a 23-slip marina for campers.  Open the Friday before Memorial Day through September 30; the gate closes at 9 p.m.  Utility-run, so ownership is private. --Claude
11046: Klamath County RV park beside the county fairgrounds at 2120 Crest Street in Klamath Falls: 48 new full-hookup sites, back-in and pull-through (30- and 50-amp), Wi-Fi, a pet area and restrooms with showers.  No tents without management approval, and no livestock trailers.  Book online before arriving; there is no on-site registration. --Claude
11073: Crook County Parks and Recreation District park on 5 acres beside the county fairgrounds in Prineville, across the road from the Crooked River: 81 full-hookup sites (30- and 50-amp), pull-throughs up to 70 ft, and two cabins.  Restrooms, showers, coin laundry, a clubhouse, playground, Wi-Fi, a pavilion and a 24-hour dump station.  No tents except seven cyclist sites, and no livestock trailers. --Claude
11131: Idaho Power park on 12 acres of lawn and trees near the town of Oxbow, on Hells Canyon Road and Oregon Highway 86: 59 RV sites with water and 30-amp power, 10 tent sites with shared water, showers, a dump station, fire rings and an EV charger.  The boat launch is half a mile downstream on Homestead Road.  Day use is free; 14 nights at most.  Utility-run, so ownership is private. --Claude
11461: Mohave County park in the pine country of the Hualapai Mountains, about 14 miles southeast of Kingman, at 4,984 to 8,417 ft: the Elk Ridge (rigs to 60 ft) and Pioneer (to 30 ft) RV campgrounds with full hookups, first-come dry sites, cabins, group areas and hiking and ATV trails.  The RV campgrounds are open May 1 to October 31 and booked ahead. --Claude
11464: Mohave County fairgrounds at 2600 Fairgrounds Boulevard in Kingman, beside I-40 and historic Route 66: RV spaces with water and electric, plenty of dry camping, overnight livestock pens and a show arena.  No dump station; two weeks at most. --Claude
11743: Two RV lots on the Del Mar Fairgrounds (22nd District Agricultural Association), minutes from the beach: Surf & Turf RV Park (60 sites) and the fairgrounds' own RV lot (58 spaces), all back-in with full hookups.  Restrooms and laundry.  Daily and weekly stays, booked up to 2 months ahead, 21 nights a calendar year at most.  Closed in summer for the San Diego County Fair and the racing season. --Claude
13093: Hilltop campground at 574 Campground Road in Fancy Gap, a mile from I-77 exit 8 and about half a mile off the Blue Ridge Parkway; the entrance is off US 52 just past the Dollar General, up a steep lane.  72 full-hookup sites (30- and 50-amp, large pull-throughs, some seasonal) and 26 tent sites; bath house with hot showers, laundry, playground, social hall with kitchen, free Wi-Fi.  Open May 1 to November 1. --Claude
14203: Campground behind the Jack Pine Lodge bar and grill on M-94, about 20 minutes north of Manistique in the Hiawatha National Forest, at the Haywire ORV trailhead: full-hookup and water-and-electric sites (30- and 50-amp), pull-throughs, rustic sites for vans and tents, and cabins.  Shower house with laundry, dump station, camp store, Wi-Fi and gas.  Nightly and seasonal stays. --Claude
14219: Family campground outside Bad Axe in the Thumb, off M-53: sites with water and electric (20/30- or 50-amp), electric-only cabins, an indoor pool, a lake, an 18-hole disc golf course and themed weekends.  Seasonal sites May through October. --Claude
14258: RV park and marina at 20 Park Avenue in Manistee, on the Manistee River where it meets Manistee Lake, with access to Lake Michigan: 187 sites, from waterfront and pull-through electric sites to full hookups, water and electric, and primitive, plus rental units, 50 marina slips, a boat ramp, a fish-cleaning station and a big camp store. --Claude
